whatThisPluginAdds.text: Exception Reports queues sanitized unhandled-exception reports to configured email recipients and optional signed webhook endpoints, with rate limiting and grouped digests.

surfaceOutcome.text: Operators receive a sanitized email or webhook payload for triage. The package has no admin resource; recipients, privacy options, and delivery behavior are configured at application level.

developers.text: A typed report boundary and sanitizer keep request secrets out of queued payloads, while trace, identity, IP, and route-parameter details remain opt-in.

teams.text: Operational failures reach the configured owner with enough context to start triage, and repeated signatures can be rate limited or summarized instead of producing duplicate alerts.
